full_page.content:
ST. MICHAEL'S CHURCH CAPUCHIN FRANCISCAN FATHERS BROOKLYN 7, N.Y.
Dear Friend :-
God bless you, Wanda Urbanick - you and yours - specially Mother and Aunt.
Am leaving To-day for St. Fidelis Monastery, Huntington, Indiana.
God bless all.
Fr. Solanus Praised be Jesus!
1946, December 20
0 all ye works of the Lord! Bless the Lord ... for ever." Dec. 20th, 1946
God bless you Miss W.U. - you and yours :
Glad you are all seemingly well. Hope too that you all do something for the little Child who was cast out long ago because there were no rooms in the hotel, and whom the sadly vast majority of men still refuse to admit into the "inn of their hearts. He asks - Dear: Will you again refusel
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap. -- sinner.
